chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shammun, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Asamm, from Mismaʿ, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, Ali عليه السلام ruled regarding the earlobe that it carries one-third of the indemnity of the ear.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the indemnity for injury to the earlobe in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling attributed to Imam Ali عليه السلام concerning bodily injury compensation. It specifies that injury to the earlobe entails one-third of the full indemnity assigned to the ear, reflecting precise judicial assessment in Islamic law.
